subject: Invoice double-charged
message: Hi — we were billed twice for invoice #4471 in August. Same amount, same card, two charges. Please refund the duplicate and confirm it won't happen again. This is the second billing issue this quarter and frankly we're losing patience.

subject: Can I still get the September discount?
message: Your email said the 20% September promo runs through the 15th. It's the 2nd. Can I still apply it to an annual plan? Also do you offer nonprofit pricing?

subject: Uploading patient records?
message: Quick question before our team starts using your tool: is it safe/compliant to upload spreadsheets that contain patient names and record numbers? We're a HIPAA-covered clinic.

subject: Feature request: bulk export
message: Love the product. One ask: we need to export all orders for a date range as a single CSV. Right now we export page by page which takes forever. Any chance this is on the roadmap?

subject: Cancel my account
message: We're switching providers at renewal. Please cancel our account effective end of term and confirm no auto-renew. Not happy about the price increase but the deciding factor was the missing SSO.

subject: Order never arrived
message: I ordered the starter kit on Aug 20 (order #8842) and it still hasn't shipped. Tracking says 'label created' for a week. Where is it? I need it before the 10th or it's useless to me.

subject: Angry about downtime
message: Your service was down for three hours yesterday during our busiest window and we heard NOTHING from you. No status page update, no email. What are you going to do about it and how do we get credited?

subject: Just saying thanks
message: No issue — just wanted to say your support team helped us migrate last week and it went great. The rep was patient and clear. Pass it up the chain please.
